description: This is a shell (.sh) script file that configures Wi-Fi interfaces, manages hostapd services, modifies network configurations, and restarts web and DHCP services on a router device. It includes functions to restart hostapd processes, manages wireless interfaces, updates configuration files, and performs network bridging tasks.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Function to restart hostapd service on the 2.4 GHz interface.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Function to restart hostapd service on the 5 GHz interface, including module reloads.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Function to restart the hostapd process on the main WLAN interface.
